name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
notes: INT8-quantized (per-channel) build of all-MiniLM-L6-v2, exported by ml/export_onnx.py: 23.0 MB, embedding parity cosine 0.9929 vs the fp32 reference, retrieval top-1 agreement 1.0.
